presentations.title: Pregnancy After Recurrent Loss: Your History and High-Risk Care - Patient Education
presentations.description: A patient-centered guide to organizing prior pregnancy-loss history, reviewing targeted evaluation, understanding APS and cervical pathways, planning early reassurance, and matching later surveillance to actual maternal and fetal risk factors.

presentations.title: Reducing Infection Transmission During Ultrasound - Provider & Sonographer Education
presentations.description: A practical 2026 SMFM-based workflow for preventing infection during external, internal, and ultrasound-guided procedures, including probe processing, covers, gel, HPV-aware high-level disinfection, storage, and unit policy.

presentations.title: A Mass Near Your Baby's Diaphragm: IEPS or CPAM? - Patient Education
presentations.description: A reassuring patient guide to fetal intra-abdominal extralobar pulmonary sequestration versus CPAM, including diaphragm anatomy, Doppler blood supply, CVR context, serial surveillance, delivery planning, and newborn evaluation.

presentations.title: Fetal Thyroid Assessment in Maternal Thyroid Disease - Provider & Sonographer Education
presentations.description: A risk-based MFM guide to fetal thyroid and neck assessment in maternal thyroid disease, including TRAb/TSI thresholds, antithyroid-drug exposure, scanning technique, hyperthyroid versus hypothyroid phenotypes, reporting, treatment, and airway-aware delivery planning.

presentations.title: AI-Assisted PACS for Maternal-Fetal Medicine - Provider & Purchaser Education
presentations.description: An evidence-based physician and purchaser guide to AI-assisted obstetric ultrasound workflows, including product classification, FDA labeling, vendor capabilities, local validation, interoperability, implementation, monitoring, and RFP design.

presentations.title: Umbilical Cord Cyst Found Later in Pregnancy - Patient Education
presentations.description: Patient-facing guide to a third-trimester umbilical cord cyst finding: what it is, why timing changes the evaluation, the genetic testing and monitoring plan, how to understand Doppler results, and delivery planning.

presentations.title: Ischemic Placental Disease and Postpartum Brain Health - Provider Education
presentations.description: A nationwide cohort of 17.4 million deliveries links ischemic placental disease (preeclampsia, placental abruption, fetal growth restriction) to a 50% higher hazard of postpartum hospitalization for neurological and psychiatric disorders, with a clear dose-response by number of IPD conditions.

presentations.title: SMFM / ACOG Delivery Timing Master Table - Provider Education
presentations.description: A physician and APP quick-reference table of evidence-based gestational-age delivery windows across twelve major maternal, fetal, and placental conditions, sourced from current ACOG and SMFM guidance.

presentations.title: One-Step vs. Two-Step GDM Screening - Provider Education
presentations.description: A provider-focused comparison of one-step and two-step gestational diabetes screening: thresholds, the Hillier NEJM RCT, USPSTF review evidence, risks and benefits of each approach, and alternatives to a formal OGTT.
